name: @rigel-cms/github-auth-template
description: Standalone GitHub App authenticator for Rigel CMS on Cloudflare, Netlify or Vercel.

GH_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID from your own GitHub App, not its numeric App ID.

GH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret from your own GitHub App. Keep this server-side.

AUTH_SECRET.description: Independent cryptographically random secret of at least 32 characters for encrypted cookies.

SITE_ORIGIN.description: Exact HTTPS gateway origin without a trailing slash. Register this origin plus /callback on your GitHub App.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Leave blank for destination confirmation, or supply exact comma-separated editor origins for restricted mode.
